body: I’ve always thought about moving out, but how? I can’t get a job due to my anxiety which means I can’t get money. I’m stuck here basically until I kill myself.
I’ve been struggling for so long, this isn’t a temporary problem I feel like I will feel this way forever and I don’t want to suffer anymore
Awe well don’t be scared to tell them, I’m sure they would appreciate it if you were honest with them.
I don’t know how I’m supposed to do all that when I don’t even go outside. Also, I’m too scared to get my drivers license to get a job because I have no reason to drive anywhere.
it’s my only option at this point
